visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a warm, well-lit living room with dark wood flooring, a shirtless muscular man in khaki cargo shorts and a woman in a black t-shirt and light blue jeans are seen spinning and hugging joyfully. A red 'Fu' character decoration hangs on the brown wall in the background. (2) The scene cuts to the couple preparing for a stunt on the floor. The woman is positioned in a bridge pose while the man stands over her; a young child sits on a yellow toy car in the background near a sofa. (3) The man straddles the woman's pelvic area and they both lift their arms and legs to find a horizontal balance point. The child on the yellow toy car rides across the foreground from left to right as they hold the pose. (4) Having successfully held the balance, the man jumps down and the couple embraces in a celebratory hug. The man then walks directly toward the camera, smiling broadly and looking into the lens, with the living room furniture visible behind him.
